method.grid: 8192 x 4096, 0-360 E, north up (the prepared density)
method.resampling: area average of native pixels, a texel missing when any overlapping native pixel is no-data; the bake route (bilinear at texel centres) differs from it in 34,234 texels (0.10%) at pixelmatch threshold 0.1
method.junoFootprint: 16 x 16 blocks of the two DLR 2 km previews (with and without Juno) where at least a quarter of pixels differ by 8 DN or more; elsewhere the previews differ by 1-2 DN (re-encoding)
method.detail: RMS of image minus its 3 x 3 mean, divided by the mean 15 x 15 local standard deviation, inside the footprint
method.registration: normalised cross-correlation of 256-texel tiles, search +-24 texels, 4-texel sampling; tiles with NCC >= 0.5 counted
